images.placement_after: “We are warriors,” Neet muttered. “Not cuddle muffins.”
images.alt_text: Freshly bathed Neet and Buddy sit in towels, with the closed clippers hidden beneath Buddy.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: The separate towel wraps leave two forepaws per dog supported on tile; Neet also has an identifiable folded hind foot beneath his wrap. Towels hide the torso and other hind anatomy naturally, without detached visible limbs.

Neet retains broad ears, tapered muzzle, narrow chest and fine front legs. Buddy retains the hanging ears, pale brows/moustache and connected neck. Exposed coats are close and smooth; towel loops are fabric, not fur.

Closed clippers peek from the right side of Buddy's seated towel. The offended forward Neet and evasively sideways Buddy communicate the bath betrayal. Bathroom furnishings and floor perspective are coherent.

images.alt_text: Neet regards the spilled plant solemnly while Buddy admires his pom-pom disguise.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: Neet has four connected grounded limbs, a full narrow body, broad ears emerging beside the beanie and a tiny nub. Buddy has a full continuous trunk, substantial supporting legs and clearance; the far hind region is partly screened by the plant/near leg.
Smooth colored torso planes avoid engraved hair or shag. Buddy's furnishings remain regional to face, ears and lower feet. The pom-pom and spilled soil are fabric/objects, not identity drift.
The upright solemn beanie wearer and open-mouth Buddy, with the intact plant tipped next to him, preserve the joke at the quoted pom-pom line. Closed apartment door carries no alternative notice.

images.placement_after: The hoodie settled between two very separate dogs.
images.alt_text: The Todd disguise collapses at the doorway, exposing two startled dogs to the manager.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: Four connected paws per dog stand on the apartment floor, separated from the discarded hoodie. Neck-to-torso connections, fine Neet legs and Buddy's substantial legs/clearance remain readable.
Neet's nub and Buddy's modest tapering tail are distinct. Both body coats have restrained smooth shading rather than curls or engraved strands; regional Buddy facial hair is retained.

Hoodie, broom and exactly three loose glue sticks make the failed disguise readable. Cropped manager legs occupy the open doorway; startled upward dog expressions retain the exposure beat. There is no urine yet, matching placement before the manager's warning and subsequent accident.

images.placement_after: Neet monitored it all from behind a ficus, wearing sunglasses and sipping beef broth like it was whiskey.
images.alt_text: Neet shelters behind the ficus with his broth while Buddy conducts friendly public relations.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: Neet sits supported on haunches behind the pot; visible forelegs connect to his narrow chest, with the bowl naturally obscuring part of the farther foot. Buddy has a continuous trunk and four grounded legs across the threshold, with depth accounting for his smaller image scale.

Neet's broad ears, cream muzzle and short coat remain recognizable behind sunglasses. Buddy has close dark torso planes and localized brows/beard/ears, not full-body shag; some pointed paint boundaries at color transitions do not form curled strands or enlarged fur volume.

Bowl sits on the floor below the lowered muzzle; no human-like gripping paw. The ficus foreground, Buddy greeting the cropped mail carrier with envelopes, and warm apartment doorway create the intended private spy/public relations contrast. No delivered notice crosses in from the alternative.

images.alt_text: Buddy meets Neet at the bottom of the stairs for their shared evening walk.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: Both dogs stand on the same flat landing. Neet's four legs can be traced; Buddy's two forelegs and one visible hind leg have distinct feet, with the other rear limb naturally occluded by the adjacent bodies. No shared or detached paw is visible.

Buddy's continuous full body remains behind his neck and forechest with real clearance. Neet retains a narrow full torso and fine limbs. Smooth body color planes, near-flush Neet nub and low tapering Buddy tail retain the photographic design; fuller Buddy ear/beard hair stays regional.

Facing heads and close shoulders communicate the warm reunion before continuing their walk. Stair flight behind is empty. Two collar leashes exit upward, with no tangling around feet. Slight body overlap does not obscure ownership or support.

images.placement_after: He intercepted Mr. Grubbs one afternoon near the mailboxes and executed a flawless sit-paw-smile combo.
images.alt_text: In the alternative, Buddy offers the manager his best diplomatic paw beside the mailboxes.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: Buddy alone sits on folded haunches with a planted forepaw, a raised forepaw connected through a bent leg, and two seated hind feet. Tail lies along the floor. The raised paw remains canine, not a hand.
Connected neck, modest projecting muzzle, pale brows/moustache and hanging ears preserve identity. Body shading stays close to the surface; localized fine edge hair does not create shag or curls.

Mailboxes, beige manager jacket and clean shoes establish the alternative diplomacy moment before the rebuff/shoe incident. Buddy looks up with an hopeful open mouth; no Neet, notice or urine imports a later or primary-only state.

images.alt_text: In the alternative, a crunchy leaf betrays Neet as Buddy calls for escape.
images.inspection: Opened actual full image using view_image detail=original at native 1536x1024; inspected entire frame.
observations: Both bodies are continuous and separate, with all four paws per dog grounded. The crunchy leaf sits directly under Neet's near front paw; fine legs, full torso and tiny nub are preserved. Buddy's torso is moderately elongated with substantial limbs and open clearance.

Smooth body color masses avoid curled or engraved coat strands. Buddy's pale muzzle/brows, hanging ears and modest tapering tail remain consistent. Leashes attach visibly to collars and remain clear of feet.

Neet's frozen alarm and Buddy's open mouth/backward attention match the escape cue. The apartment door is open and bears a notice only in this alternative; no primary beanie/Todd objects appear. This is the female-Neet alternative and no depicted sex detail contradicts that continuity.
